detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
schema=""
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no package.json, this is not a JavaScript or TypeScript project" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
for f in openapi.yaml openapi.yml openapi.json; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then schema="$f"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$schema" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no repository-owned OpenAPI file here" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: compare repository-owned OpenAPI artifacts by hand against the checked-in source; do not fetch or adopt an external schema

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned range no longer resolves in the manager the lockfile names

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
ver="$(node -v 2>/dev/null)" || ver=""
major="${ver#v}"
major="${major%%.*}"
case "$major" in "" | *[!0-9]*) major=0 ;; esac
if [ "$major" -lt 20 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: this recipe needs Node 20 or newer, the host reports major $major" >&2
  exit 78
fi
schema=""
for f in openapi.yaml openapi.yml openapi.json; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then schema="$f"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$schema" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no repository-owned OpenAPI file here" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "@redocly/cli@^1.25.15"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "@redocly/cli@^1.25.15"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "@redocly/cli@^1.25.15"; fi

probe.command:
if grep -qE '"@redocly/cli"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
if grep -qE '"swagger-cli"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
for f in redocly.yaml .redocly.yaml redocly.yml .redocly.yml; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi
done
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall @redocly/cli
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove @redocly/cli
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove @redocly/cli
fi

smoke.command:
schema=""
for f in openapi.yaml openapi.yml openapi.json; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then schema="$f"; break; fi
done
if [ -z "$schema" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: no repository-owned OpenAPI file here" >&2
  exit 78
fi
case "$schema" in
  http://*|https://*)
    echo "nightshift: smoke validates a local file only, not a remote schema URL" >&2
    exit 78
    ;;
esac
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm exec --no -- @redocly/cli lint "$schema"
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm exec @redocly/cli lint "$schema"
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn run redocly lint "$schema"
else
  echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
